The background is a forest of skyscrapers, with the glass curtain wall reflecting a sea of neon lights. The warm yellow street lamps and the cold blue window display light interweave and flow. Her outline was outlined by the soft street lamps, her face bathed in the warm ambient light, while in the distance, the dazzling car headlights dragged out long light tracks on the moist street.
